title: Duolingo Plus / Clear space
slide_intent: Protect a product signature from nearby content because recognition depends on separating the complete lockup from its surroundings.
strategic_value: Clear space can keep the Duolingo name and Plus token readable as one identifier.
demonstration: A Plus clearance diagram is beside a prohibition on placing graphics or text in the shown area.
practical_value: Keep nearby objects outside the diagrammed Plus exclusion zone.

content_islands.name: Plus clearance
content_islands.spec: Retain the full product lockup and its marked boundary in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Exclusion instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and no-objects rule in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says clear space allows the logotype to stand out.

reference_purposes.Constraint: Objects such as graphics or text cannot be placed in the shown area.
